title: A starter: the walk a new host takes from nothing to a served, checked install (ADR-023)
description: Published BESIDE the kit, like an adapter or a bundle, and read by the `start` verb, which holds none of it. A starter decides what a host RUNS -- what it takes, which runtimes it serves, which settings outside the tree it activates -- and never what it HOLDS: no stance, no law, no answer a host owes in its own words.

takes.description: Each published capability directory to take, relative to this starter's file.

runtimes.description: Each runtime instance to serve, written as the host's runtime declaration when it has none by that id; validated by the schema that declaration honours, never restated here.

activate.description: Each served surface whose setting outside the tree is pointed at what it serves, through `activate`.
